classification: allocator high-water correctness repair and corrected current baseline; no optimization claim
isolation: fresh process per selector/repeat; task CPU workloads serialized; shared host background uncontrolled
hypothesis: Atomic fetch_update returns the previous live total; forwarding it to peak can miss transient allocations. Correct post-update accounting must preserve current live totals and cumulative request counts.
acceptance: Deterministic regression tests fail before correction and pass afterward. Corrected raw snapshots must satisfy peak >= live at each quiescent observation; reports retain exact corpus/output/refusal gates.
limits: No allocator elapsed-time comparison, no performance improvement claim, no operation-local peak or physical realloc-overlap measurement. Existing historical peak fields are suspect and remain immutable.
